messages:
sofia: quick sync — thought experiment: planning a surgical cutover to make a set of tenants EU-primary for data residency without doing full active/active. want to capture the tradeoffs and an executable canary plan.

jamal: +1. big questions: what is the residency contract? how do we detect/trigger fallback to global?

sofia: proposal sketch: control plane stays global but dataplane becomes EU-primary for selected tenants. fallback triggered on dataplane outage or sustained capacity < 10% for 3m. fallback state = 'soft-evacuated' so that reads still service but writes go to global variant.

ben: major concern = KV cache ownership. if we flip traffic we need a safe lease/handoff path for per-tenant caches and any in-memory shards. otherwise we get double-writes or stale reads.

sofia: agree. handoff protocol idea (operator-run):
```
1) operator writes tenant key 'handoff-init' with epoch
2) old-primary drains new writes for N seconds (suggest 120s) and flushes prefix cache to durable store
3) operator atomically swaps lease/ownership marker and signals new-primary to warm caches
```
This keeps it single-writer but requires draining window.

elena: edge proxies need idempotency and inflight request handling. if we drain for 120s, clients might retry and hit new-primary — need replay-safe semantics or an idempotency token.

jamal: also add telemetry fields: surgery_reason, handshake_epoch, drain_start_ts, drain_end_ts for every handoff event. makes postmortem easier.

ben: automation plan: implement `handoff-operator` service that orchestrates the 3-step flow and emits events to ops-log. operator should be able to run dry-runs.

sofia: canary plan suggestion: 1 tenant -> 5 tenants -> 20 tenants -> subset of customer cohort over 24h. success metrics: no >2x median latency, <0.5% increase in 95th, error-rate delta <0.5%. rollback on breach.

deploy-bot: CI for branch `eu-surgery/handoff-operator` passed. smoke tests green. :rocket:

elena: API surface we need: `POST /tenants/{id}/region-surgery` with body `{\"target_region\":\"eu\", \"dry_run\":true}` and an async operation id. operator can PATCH `/operations/{id}/approve` to progress.

jamal: KMS concern: if tenant requires EU KMS key, the handoff must ensure decrypt/rotate flows remain EU-local. add gating check before starting operator.

ben: deploy considerations: ensure the new-primary has quantized model variants if applicable, and that model artifacts are pre-warmed. otherwise you'll see cold-cache latency spikes.

sofia: good note. include pre-warm step in operator: fetch model artifacts, pre-populate kv hotset.

elena: tests: add chaos test that kills the old-primary during drain and verifies no data loss and consistent idempotency behavior.

sofia: next actions: I'll open an RFC checklist summarizing handoff steps, canary plan, telemetry, and KMS gating. Ben will own the first PR for `handoff-operator`. Elena owns proxy idempotency changes and the API. Jamal owns operator tests and telemetry.

ben: i'll pick up the PR and tag reviewers.

sofia: cool — i'll update the runbook and add rollback playbook (how to revert and rebind tenants). thanks all. :white_check_mark:

jamal: thanks. ping in #eng-oncall when we start canary so SRE can watch the metrics.
